title: AskALCF: A Self-Improving Agentic System for Intelligent HPC User Support
abstract: arXiv:2611.15700v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-based question-answering systems are increasingly used for user support, including at high-performance computing (HPC) facilities. However, existing systems lack a systematic, deployment-oriented approach for evaluating final-answer quality and attributing failures to specific components. They also remain largely static after deployment, apart from periodic knowledge-base updates.   We present AskALCF, an agentic log-analysis and improvement pipeline for HPC user support. AskALCF evaluates production interactions at a fine-grained level, identifies whether failures arise from missing knowledge, retrieval, prompting, model behavior, or tool execution, and routes each failure to an actionable repair. Its diagnostic core combines answer-quality assessment with a two-scope sufficiency test that distinguishes information missing from the documentation corpus from information present but not retrieved. translated_title: AskALCF：一个用于智能高性能计算（HPC）用户支持的自改进智能体系统
translated_abstract: 基于人工智能的问答系统正越来越多地被用于用户支持，包括在高性能计算（HPC）设施中。然而，现有系统缺乏一种系统的、面向部署的方法来评估最终答案的质量，并将失败归因于具体的组件。此外，除了周期性的知识库更新之外，这些系统在部署后基本保持静态。我们提出了AskALCF，这是一个面向HPC用户支持的智能体化日志分析与改进流水线。AskALCF在细粒度层面评估生产环境中的交互，识别失败究竟源于知识缺失、检索、提示词、模型行为还是工具执行，并将每一类失败路由至可操作的修复方案。其诊断核心将答案质量评估与一种双范围充分性测试相结合，该测试能够区分文档语料库中确实缺失的信息与虽存在但未被检索到的信息。我们还进一步引入了一种受控的……
tldr: AskALCF是一个面向HPC用户支持的自改进智能体系统，可对生产交互进行细粒度评估，将失败精准归因于知识缺失、检索、提示、模型或工具执行等具体环节，并自动路由至相应的修复方案。
en_tdlr: AskALCF is a self-improving agentic system for HPC user support that evaluates production interactions at a fine-grained level, attributes failures to specific components such as missing knowledge, retrieval, prompting, model behavior, or tool execution, and routes each failure to an actionable repair.
